recommendation: Keep this narrow non-substantive clarification. It completes FHIR-7155 in the active Observation source while respecting the later FHIR-12679 pattern context; any broader decision to fully align Observation.identifier definition and requirements with Event.identifier should be handled separately by OO.
issue_request: FHIR-7155 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1 Observation.identifier. It asked to add "instance" after "observation" and to address the scope of identifier uniqueness through a discussion link.
initial_application: The historical application commit 89739dcf150cb051d4f4a26d48e1a827649c9af5 (#7152,7155,7157) changed the old Observation spreadsheet definition from "A unique identifier for the simple observation" to "A unique identifier for the simple observation instance." It did not add separate scope/comment text. Later commit 2c8fb553cfc67b9b93eca7789fc412e6e4613d42 for FHIR-12679 changed the short/definition to the current event-pattern-style wording, which dropped the explicit "instance" word.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-12679 is a later Published/Persuasive OO decision to harmonize Observation.identifier with the Event pattern, and the Event pattern now includes the business-identifier comment with a discussion link and resource-instance uniqueness guidance. Zulip discussions in 2016 and 2018 show implementers asked whether Observation.identifier identifies the instance versus an observation type/code; Lloyd McKenzie answered that it is for the instance. Confluence searches found no conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: Updated source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml so Observation.identifier says "this observation instance" and includes the Event.identifier business-identifier comment. Updated source/observation/observation-event-mapping-exceptions.xml to match the changed resource definition and remove the obsolete comment mismatch now that Observation carries the Event comment.
source_changes: source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml: Observation.identifier definition now says "A unique identifier assigned to this observation instance." and includes the business-identifier/resource-identifier scope comment with a discussion link.

source/observation/observation-event-mapping-exceptions.xml: Updated the Observation.identifier definition exception text and removed the commentsUnmatched entry because the resource now uses the Event.identifier comment.
